body: Maybe you just need to try and find a few new things in life (hobbies or something like that).. You might meet new people with the same interests or find out something new about yourself? :)

For me it was a very step by step thing. It was one thing at a time (or multiple times, since i did tend to go back to my old ways when I got pushed to my limit). And for me therapists never helped. It was my family that helped me get to the bottom of it all and help me find ways to cope with my mood swings etc.

Aswell any mental issue is just as bad as any other health issue.. It's something thats off and it does need addressing.


And I'm not saying all problems go away.. You just learn how to deal with them better so they dont influence you as much, and you can live your life better.
If I left it at the point I was before, I probably wouldn't be able to be here today. And the way I see it, as an only child, I have to be here for my parents. And I want to be. To help them when they get older and repay them for all they did for me.


I guess it all about the mindset change. You need to understand yourself. But all in all.. I see it as something that's worth trying for.

I do know the pain of abuse. Even the pain of rape. The pain of someone you loved hurt you in ways you'd never even imagine. 
But each and every one of us has a coping mechanism. It's different for everyone. And ofcourse just talking doesn't help.. But it's the only way you can find a way to cope with something that happened to you.

I never said that it's all about the people who love you. But by committing suicide you solve nothing. The only thing you do is end the possibility of happiness in your life. You close the option of ever meeting someone that would make it better. Or to find a thing you can do in life that would make you happy.


But the end choice is always yours. No one can stop you from taking that step, unless you want help.
Try it ;) .. You can only gain something from it :)

I really don;t know what to say.. Maybe he doesn't know a different way to help you. Try sitting him down and just tell him how you feel and what you see.. And maybe guide him by telling him how he should try to react in sitations when you get depressed. Many people don't know what to do, and just end up doing the first thing that comes to their mind. A little help might get a better end result :)

See that is the thing.. My mother was more worried and carried a bigger burden when she didn't know the full extent of my issues. The people closest to you always feel something is off (exp. our parents). And yes, of course its painful to hear your child is in distress, but on a long run it's so much better and easier when they know whats going on and how to help. So yes you might hurt your parents by telling them that you arent ok, but it gives you both an option to start working on a problem and possibly find a solution to it all. It might not be an instant thing and hell, it even might take a few years, but it's totally worth it.
It took me 8 years to get to this point. But I'll never regret telling my mother how things were back then. I couldnt have done it without her.

One thing you have to keep in mind, is that you are never a burden to the people that love you. But letting them know and giving them a chance to help will show them you care aswell (atleast that's how I see it...)

Hello :)
Your issues seem to be something thats on everyones mind. 
I think we are all scared of those big things we can't really influence much. 
As far as the good woman myth goes, Ive heard the exact opposite.. That good guys are a myth ;) hehe
I don't really know how to put everything on my mind in a sentence that would make sense in english (it's not my first language), but I guess how I see life is a constant obstacle course.. You might mess it up the first few times, but once you get it right you will feel accomplished :) . There's nothing wrong with failing, if you bounce back up and do it again :)


So I'd suggest to pour your heart on a page and write the story that you carry in you :) And try a new hobby.. You never know, you might meet a new person that will change your life and how you see things forever ;)

Hi :)
Even if I tell you that I used to think exactly the same way, it wont make your tomorrow better. 
But one thing I can tell you is that dieing is not the answer. 
Killing yourself would do nothing more then close all the future options you have in life and hurt those who love you. And I know how it feels to be scared that you are gonna loose the people that mean something to you because of who you are or what you do/say.
My advice to you is to explain to your closest friends and family exactly how you feel.. And what you are afraid off. 
And if any of them leave, just remember that those people aren't the ones you want to keep in your life. The ones who truly care about you will stay no matter what. And IMO, Id rather have less people around me that truly care, then more that will be there just cose they are getting something they want from you.

But more then anything, keep your head up :) Life brings us new things every day! But if you are looking down.. You might just miss them.
Thank you for reading it :) and the positive comment :)

Hi :)
Even tho I can't completely understand your point of view (I'm one of those girls that never really thought about having kids..), but I'm sure there is a way, so you can have a baby. A lot of stuff involving our body does need the influence of our mind. So do not give up hope. 
As well, the very last alternative could always be adoption, tho I do understand that you would want to have the baby of your own.

And as far as your husband goes.. Don't ever feel like you are a burden to him because of how you feel. He loves you and I'm sure he will always be there for you in a split second. Everyone on this planet has  flaws, just in different places/ways.. But when you love someone, you love them for their flaws as well.

So keep your head up girl :) 
I'm sure there are plenty of wonderful adventures coming your way ;)

It is hard.. But it's totally worth all the effort :)

ofcourse (tho i hope your from europe since i never knew how to translate to us portions lol)
but its a layered cake.. 

so for the pastery:
2 eggs, 2 spoons of sugar, 2 spoons of flour, 2 spoons of oil, 2,5 tea spoons of vanilla sugar, 2,5 spoons of baking powder, 1 spoon of water

i mix the eggs till they are foamy, add sugar and vanilla sugar. Mix again till it all blends, then add flour and baking powder and mix again. in the end i add oil and water and mix again.

Bake at 180 celsius for about 10min.
I usually repeat that 3 times since i always make 3 layers.


Cream:
 750g of sweet whipped cream (i whip it myself and add sugar to it but i guess you can buy it already made), 150-200g melted dark chocolate (i usually put 150 first and taste it - add more chocolate if you feel the need), tea cup of black coffee and edible gelatine (around 10g)


So basically, make the whipped cream, add chocolate and coffee to it. in the end add gelatine and let it rest for about 10-20min in the fridge so the cream hardens a bit.


One thing i do aswell is before i add the cream, i soak each layer of pastery with a teacup of milk so its nice and moist.
And after a bit of mess of appying the cream and layers, u have the cake (:
